claims.text: The proposed framework includes an error taxonomy for classifying LLM outputs.
The proposed framework includes an experimental structure for iterative comparisons in an LLM document generation pipeline.
The proposed framework includes a clinical safety framework to evaluate the harms of errors.
The proposed framework includes a graphical user interface, CREOLA, to facilitate evaluation processes.
Evaluating LLMs for clinical note generation yielded a 1.47% hallucination rate.
Evaluating LLMs for clinical note generation yielded a 3.45% omission rate.
Refining prompts and workflows reduced major errors in LLM clinical note generation below previously reported human note-taking rates.

evidence.description: By refining prompts and workflows, we successfully reduced major errors below previously reported human note-taking rates

methodologies.name: CREOLA Clinical Assessment Framework
methodologies.description: A framework comprising an error taxonomy, an iterative experimental comparison structure, a clinical safety framework, and a graphical user interface (CREOLA) to assess clinical LLM documentation.
